```lean
induction n with d hd
· exact (le_refl 3)
· rw [pow_two, mul_add, add_assoc]
  calc
    (d + 1) * (d + 1) ≥ 2 * (d + 1) + 3 := by
      rw [mul_add, add_assoc]
      apply le_add_right
      refine le_trans (hd) (add_le_add_right (le_refl 3) _)
      exact le_add_right (le_refl 2) 3
```
